restrictions.reason: Recordings must be made against a production build. Dev-server module reloading corrupts them.
The proxy is a test-time tool. Routing an application's API base URL through it in production is unsafe; it must be gated on TEST_PROXY_RECORDER_ENABLED.
Redaction of Authorization, Cookie, and Set-Cookie headers is on by default and prevents real tokens being committed with recordings.
The Next.js middleware only exposes the recording id; registerProxyFetch() is what tags server-side fetches.
This is an independent MIT-licensed project that integrates with Playwright. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft or the Playwright team.
The API reference at https://test-proxy-recorder.dev/docs/reference/api/ is generated from the package's own TypeScript types. Read it rather than recalling signatures.
